stimulus:    Junk foods usually comprise of high (a) (calorie). These (b) (artificial) made foods look (c) (charm) and appetizing. These foods are (d)  (prepare) commercially (e)  (ignore) the nutritive value. Frequent (f)  (take) of these foods leads to obesity. Obesity (g)  (lead) to fatty material (h)  (build) up in arteries. The (i)  (damage) arteries increase the risk  of heart attack. Moreover, (j) (eat) junk foods damages the brain.
guide_solution: (a) calories; (b) artificially; (c) charming; (d) prepared; (e) ignoring; (f) intake; (g) leads; (h) building; (i) damaged; (j) overeating.
